mismatch.right: An ogre lord walks up while four weak monsters fight the warrior: leave, or at least don't engage it.

attrition.right: A long fight on six bandages and one heal potion: disengage before the supplies are gone, unless the last monster is nearly dead.

tamer-ogre-lord.right: An ogre lord walks up to a tamer with a grizzly bear, two orcs with it. Neither can beat it, and it runs as fast as the tamer: leave early, and if it catches up, let the bear hold it off. The tamer must survive; losing the bear is reported.

swarm.right: Six melee monsters on a mage: survive and kill at least four.
